title: Craft in Monochrome: Building with Paper, Ink, and Physics
excerpt: Why color restraint forces better typography, spatial hierarchy, and tactile feel in interface design.
body: When color is reserved solely for interactive particles, every structural choice in UI must stand on its own feet. Paper, ink, and hairline borders create a quiet baseline where motion and typography tell the entire story.

title: Text-Aware Canvas Dimming at 60fps
excerpt: How to register DOM bounding boxes and compute proximity field dimming without killing the render loop.
body: Particles yield to text. If there is ever a conflict, the text wins. Here is how we balance DOM rect queries with high-throughput 2D canvas loops using throttling and spatial hash lookups.
